title: Rhythm Rodeo: BoomBox-Driven Horse Dance Choreographer
description: A horse stands in a spotlight on a stage with a giant BoomBox nearby. The user controls the BoomBox to trigger different beat modes, each causing the horse to perform a unique procedural dance animation with adjustable tempo, intensity, and style. Users choreograph a full dance sequence by layering beats and tweaking parameters in real time.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements an interactive horse dance choreography system. Load both GLB assets: BoomBox.glb (scaled up 150x, placed stage-left on a pedestal) and horse.glb (centered on a circular stage platform). Set up a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 3, 8) looking at the horse, with OrbitControls enabled. Add a dark environment with a ground plane, a SpotLight on the horse, and colored PointLights that change with the beat mode. Create an HTML overlay panel with these interactive controls: (1) A 'Beat Mode' dropdown with 4 options — Trot Funk, Gallop Disco, Canter Waltz, Freestyle Chaos — each triggering a distinct procedural animation on the horse by programmatically rotating and translating the horse's skeleton bones (neck, legs, spine) using sinusoidal functions with different frequencies and amplitudes. (2) A 'Tempo' slider (range 0.5 to 3.0, default 1.0) that scales the animation speed. (3) An 'Intensity' slider (range 0.1 to 2.0, default 1.0) that scales bone rotation amplitudes. (4) A 'BoomBox Pulse' checkbox that, when enabled, makes the BoomBox scale rhythmically (pulsing between 0.95x and 1.05x its size) in sync with the tempo. (5) A 'Stage Lights' color picker that sets the SpotLight color on the horse. (6) A 'Spin Stage' toggle that slowly rotates the ground platform and horse together. (7) A 'Record Sequence' button that captures the current parameter state into an array, and a 'Play Sequence' button that plays back up to 5 recorded states in order, each lasting 2 seconds, transitioning smoothly between parameter sets. Validate that at least 2 states are recorded before playback is allowed. The BoomBox should glow with an emissive material tint matching the current beat mode. Display the current beat mode name as floating 3D text above the BoomBox using a sprite. Animate everything in the render loop using delta time from THREE.Clock.
